<function name="GetTable" parent="sound" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns a list of all registered [sound scripts](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Soundscripts).

New ones can be registered using <page>sound.Add</page>, and detailed information about each one can be retrieved via <page>sound.GetProperties</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table<string>">The list/array of all registered sound scripts ( No other information is provided )</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Writes all the sound scripts to a file in the data folder for easy searching.</description>
	<code>file.Write("soundscripts.txt",table.concat(sound.GetTable(),"\n"))</code>
	<output>
